newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks close down 4.47 pct on Wall St.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks close down 4.47 pct on Wall St.

text.p: Argentine stocks closed down 4.47 percent on Monday as a big slide on Wall Street sent the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange reeling, traders said.
Buenos Aires -- which was closed last Thursday and Friday -- took a double-whammy from the New York Stock Exchange, which also fell in its last session before the Easter break.
The blue-chip MerVal index .MERV ended at 706.
Still, traders insisted local investors kept their nerve and were not panicked into big selling, with most of the downward momentum coming from slumping American Depositary Receipts.
